process_area.title: Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application

value_stream.name: Auto-ID, Barcode, RFID, Price-Tag Labeling & EAS Operations

fields.Trigger: Fleet ops; consumable reorder; new store (VS-37)
fields.Volume: Label printers + media (thermal rolls, tags, ribbons) across 200 stores + 4 DCs + HQ

workflows.name: Label Production Fleet Operations & Consumable Management

Automation Opportunity: - Printer media-level monitoring → auto-reorder; predictive PM on printhead wear; consumable spend analytics
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: media supply chain-controlled (VS-23); printer fleet PM'd (VS-138/VS-99); RA 7394 stock continuity
Cross-references: - links to VS-99 (ITAM), VS-34 (procurement), VS-138 (IFM), VS-27.1 (service desk), VS-23 (shrink), W4485 (hardware standard)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stockout-of-media risk**: Store runs out of label stock → no price tags (RA 7394 risk); mitigated by min-max auto-reorder
- **Counterfeit-media risk**: Unauthorized media/labels enable tag-switch fraud (VS-23); mitigated by controlled supply & serialized media
System Touchpoints: - ITAM fleet (VS-99); procurement/consumables (VS-34); IFM PM (VS-138); service desk (VS-27.1); shrink control (VS-23)
Time Estimate: - ~15 min/day per store media ops; ~weekly consumable replenishment

steps.activity: Stores/IT operate the per-store label-printer fleet (load media, replace ribbons, clean printheads), following the W4485 standard and IFM preventative maintenance (VS-138)

Procurement/Auto-ID Lead manage consumable supply (media/ribbon min-max per store, central reorder, vendor consolidation VS-34), with shrink-controlled media (links to VS-23 — media is a fraud/counterfeit vector)
IT/ITAM track printer fleet health, PM, and refresh via VS-99, and feed failures to the service desk (VS-27.1)

fields.Trigger: Price/promo change; new-item setup; reprint request
fields.Volume: Print jobs across 35K SKUs × 200 stores; bi-monthly sale events

Automation Opportunity: - Price-change-driven auto job generation; print-receipt confirmation; compliance-close in task app (VS-63)
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: print job receipt-confirmed & application-compliance-closed; RA 7394 price current (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-137 (PIM), VS-01.2/VS-58 (pricing/promo), VS-63 (task mgmt), VS-27 (IT), W4491/W4492 (application), W4496 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-print risk**: Job not printed/applied → stale price (RA 7394/VS-118 risk); mitigated by receipt confirmation + compliance close
- **Volume-spike risk**: Bi-monthly sale events overwhelm printers; mitigated by staged job scheduling
System Touchpoints: - PIM/template (VS-137); pricing (VS-01.2); store task mgmt (VS-63); IT distribution (VS-27); promo (VS-58)
Time Estimate: - Per job minutes; bi-monthly events ~0.5 day/store

steps.activity: Pricing/Auto-ID Lead generate print jobs from the PIM/template library (VS-137/W4483) — shelf-edge, hang-tag, adhesive — filtered by store/section/SKU and effective date
IT distribute print jobs to store/DC printers (push to RF/PC printers), confirm print receipt, and log the job for reconciliation (W4496)
Stores execute the print job, apply labels (W4491/W4492), and close the job with application confirmation/compliance (links to VS-63 task mgmt)

fields.Trigger: Price change; reset; new-item; audit gap

Automation Opportunity: - RF-guided label-to-facing scan-match; stale-label detector (price-change vs applied); shelf-edge image audit
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: label-to-facing verified; stale labels replaced; RA 7394 price accuracy audited (W4486/VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-55 (planogram), VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-63 (task mgmt), VS-118 (revenue assurance), W4486 (conformance), W4490 (print job)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-facing risk**: Label under wrong SKU → scan/price error (VS-118); mitigated by label-to-facing verification
- **Stale-label risk**: Old price left after change → over/under-charge + RA 7394 violation; mitigated by replace-old-first rule
System Touchpoints: - Planogram (VS-55); pricing (VS-01.2); store task mgmt (VS-63); revenue assurance (VS-118); W4486 conformance

steps.activity: Stock associates apply shelf-edge price labels per the print job/planogram (VS-55), matching label to facing and verifying barcode/price/unit correctness (RA 7394)
Supervisor verify shelf-edge compliance vs planogram (VS-55) and price accuracy (W4486), and flag/reprint mismatches
Stores capture shelf-edge compliance in the task app (VS-63) and feed exceptions to Revenue Assurance (VS-118)

fields.Volume: Hang-tags/adhesive on tools/hardware/appliances; bulk-yard tags on lumber/cement/tiles

Automation Opportunity: - Receipt-driven tag-print trigger; durable-media selection by environment; yard-tag re-issue on cycle-count gap
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: items tagged at receipt before floor; high-value EAS-tagged (W4484); bulk-tag durable & lot-traced
Cross-references: - links to VS-07.3 (receiving), VS-04 (DC), VS-23 (LP/EAS), VS-29 (lot), W4482/W4494 (variable), W4498 (source-tagging)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Untagged-at-receipt risk**: Item hits floor without tag → can't sell/scan; mitigated by receipt tagging gate
- **Bulk-tag-loss risk**: Yard tags weather off lumber/cement; mitigated by durable media + cycle re-tag
System Touchpoints: - Receiving (VS-07.3/VS-04); WMS putaway (VS-04); LP/EAS (VS-23/W4484); lot trace (VS-29/W4482); catch-weight (VS-08)

steps.activity: Receiving applies hang-tags/adhesive price tags at goods receipt for items lacking source-tagging (links to VS-07.3/VS-04), verifying barcode readability (W4486)
Lumber/bulk-yard staff apply bulk-yard tags (price/board-foot, lot) to lumber/cement/tiles, with catch-weight/variable format (W4494) and lot traceability (W4482)
LP/Stores ensure high-value items carry the EAS tag per policy (W4484) at tagging time (source-tagging preferred W4498)

fields.Participants: Auto-ID Lead, Marketing (VS-14), Promotions (VS-58), Task mgmt (VS-63)
fields.Trigger: Price change (VS-01.2); promo (VS-58); bi-monthly sale event
fields.Volume: Re-labeling across affected SKUs × stores per change

Automation Opportunity: - Effective-time-coordinated job+POS sync; mobile re-label checklist with scan-confirm; stale-label exception
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: re-labeling before effective time; old labels removed; shelf/POS consistency verified (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2/VS-58 (pricing/promo), W4488 (sync), VS-63 (task), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-08.3 (override)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Timing-mismatch risk**: Shelf shows old, POS charges new (or vice-versa) → customer dispute + RA 7394; mitigated by effective-time coordination & remove-old-first
- **Incomplete-relabel risk**: Some facings missed → stale price; mitigated by compliance close & exception report
System Touchpoints: - Pricing (VS-01.2); promo (VS-58); POS sync (W4488); task mgmt (VS-63); revenue assurance (VS-118); override audit (VS-08.3)
Time Estimate: - Per change ~2–4 hr/store; major sale event ~0.5–1 day

steps.activity: Pricing/Auto-ID Lead generate the re-label job for affected SKUs/stores with effective-time coordination to POS (W4488) and promo tags (VS-58), staged to avoid peak-hour disruption
Stores execute re-labeling before effective time, remove old labels first (avoid stale-price RA 7394 risk), and confirm via task app (VS-63)
Pricing/Revenue Assurance verify shelf/POS price consistency post-change (links to VS-118), investigate overrides (VS-08.3), and close the change

fields.Participants: POS (VS-08), Custom fabrication (VS-09.1), Calibration (VS-115), Revenue Assurance (VS-118)
fields.Volume: Variable-measure labels at 600 POS + cutting stations every store

workflows.name: Catch-Weight / Variable-Measure Labeling at POS & Cutting

Automation Opportunity: - Scale→label→POS auto-posting (no manual entry); calibration-expiry lock on scale
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: scales calibrated (VS-115); variable-measure scanned not keyed; price = weight × unit verified (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-09.1 (cutting), VS-115 (calibration), VS-118 (revenue assurance), W4482 (format), W4486 (read-rate)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mismeasure risk**: Uncalibrated scale → wrong price (revenue loss/overcharge VS-118); mitigated by VS-115 calibration gate
- **Keying-error risk**: Manual weight entry → error; mitigated by variable-barcode scan (no manual)
System Touchpoints: - POS catch-weight (VS-08); cutting/fabrication (VS-09.1); calibration (VS-115); revenue assurance (VS-118); W4482 format

steps.activity: Cashier/cutting staff weigh/measure catch-weight items on calibrated scales (VS-115) and print the variable-measure label (weight/length, unit price, total, barcode) using the W4482 format
POS scans the variable-measure barcode to ring exact price (links to VS-08), preventing keying error (VS-118)
Calibration/Auto-ID Lead ensure scales/printers are calibrated (VS-115) and variable-format labels pass the W4486 read-rate standard

fields.Participants: Pricing (VS-01.2), Auto-ID Lead, Marketing (VS-14), Revenue Assurance (VS-118)
fields.Volume: Markdown labels across seasonal/clearance SKUs (~500 seasonal + clearance)

Automation Opportunity: - Markdown-job auto-generation; clean-label-over enforcement; markdown-integrity audit (VS-118)
Controls: - CTL-684 (ensure controlled execution — Label & Price-Tag Production, Printing & In-Store Application (PA-151.2).)
- CTL-684: single current price (no old-label ambiguity); markdown SKU/% correct; no unauthorized stacking (VS-118/VS-58)
Cross-references: - links to VS-64 (seasonal/clearance), VS-01.2 (pricing), W4488 (sync), VS-58 (promo/discount), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-23 (tag-switch)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tag-switch-fraud risk**: Old label left visible enables price manipulation (VS-23); mitigated by clean label-over + single-current-price rule
- **Markdown-leakage risk**: Wrong SKU/% or discount stacking (VS-118); mitigated by markdown integrity audit
System Touchpoints: - Seasonal/clearance (VS-64); pricing (VS-01.2); POS sync (W4488); promo/discount (VS-58); revenue assurance (VS-118)
Time Estimate: - Per markdown cycle ~2–4 hr/store; seasonal ~1 day

steps.activity: Merchandising/Pricing generate markdown/clearance label jobs (was/now price, markdown reason, clearance) per the seasonal plan (VS-64), with POS price coordination (W4488)
Stores apply markdown labels (over old price cleanly — no tag-switch ambiguity), update shelf-edge, and execute the seasonal transition (VS-64)
Revenue Assurance/Pricing verify markdown integrity (right SKU, right %, no double-discount stacking VS-118/VS-58) and recover/report leakage

fields.Volume: Application-quality audit + end-of-life media control across 205 sites

workflows.name: Label Application Quality, Reconciliation & End-of-Life Media Control

Automation Opportunity: - Print-vs-applied reconciliation analytics; media-issue/destruction log; consumable-waste tracking (VS-73)
Controls: - CTL-684: print job reconciled to application (VS-118); end-of-life media secured/destroyed (VS-23); media waste compliant (VS-73)
Cross-references: - links to VS-31/W4486 (quality), VS-23 (LP/media), VS-73 (waste), VS-21 (audit), VS-135 (consumables), W4490 (print job)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unreconciled-job risk**: Printed ≠ applied → untracked price gaps (VS-118); mitigated by job-application reconciliation
- **Media-misuse risk**: Discarded labels/ribbons enable fraud/counterfeit (VS-23); mitigated by secure media destruction
System Touchpoints: - Quality audit (VS-31/W4486); LP/shrink (VS-23); waste/circular (VS-73); audit (VS-21); TBM/consumables (VS-135)

steps.activity: Auto-ID Lead/Quality run application-quality audits (label present, correct, readable, planogram-matched) per W4486, reconcile print jobs vs applied (W4490), and quantify the gap
LP/Auto-ID Lead control end-of-life media — collect/destroy obsolete price labels/tags and spent ribbons to prevent tag-switch fraud and counterfeit-label reuse (links to VS-23)
Sustainability/Stores ensure label media waste is handled per the circular-economy/waste program (VS-73) and consumable spend is reported (VS-135)
